# PLANARIA

> Progressive Holographic Executable Architecture (`.hbin`), Plang Compiler, PVM-32 Vascular Anastomosis VM, 4-Qubit Temporal-Quantum WebGL2 Studio, and 6-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Formal Verification Suite (`v2.3.0`).

# AGENTS.md

Canonical instructions for every coding agent working in `0thernes/planaria`.
`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc`, and `llms.txt` point here. Edit this file, never the pointers.
Full standard: [docs/build-standard.md](docs/build-standard.md) (Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0, 90 items).

## Project

- **Name:** PLANARIA (`v2.3.0`)
- **Purpose:** Progressive holographic executable architecture (`.hbin`), Plang compiler, PVM-32 vascular anastomosis VM, 4-qubit/temporal 3D WebGL2 Studio, and 6-kernel pure Lean 4.35.0 formal verification suite.
- **Owner:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`0thernes`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`, Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA — NOT an LLC).
- **Manifest:** [repo.yaml](repo.yaml) (schema: [repo-standard.schema.json](repo-standard.schema.json)) and [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml).
- **Stack:** Zero-dependency ES2022 JavaScript (`Node.js >= 20`, WebGL2 GLSL 300 es, 48 kHz AudioWorklet), pure Lean 4.35.0 (`module` system, zero Mathlib), AMS-LaTeX (`tectonic`).
- **Layout:**
  - `src/core/` — GF(2^8), interleaved RS(254,238), Cauchy MDS, FIPS 180-4 SHA-256, Depth-8 Merkle, `.hbin` codec, torture suite
  - `src/compiler/` — Plang ISA, lexer, recursive-descent parser, register-windowed codegen, compiler entrypoint
  - `src/vm/` — PVM-32 sandboxed VM (`& 0xFFF` RAM, bounded budgets, 6-organ anastomosis) & LINBIN01 linear control twin
  - `src/quantum/` — 4-qubit complex statevector (`qengine.js`: Horodecki CHSH, Mermin GHZ, WKB, Heisenberg, Zeno) & `TemporalEngine` (`temporal.js`: O(1) 360-frame RingBuffer)
  - `src/world/` — Deterministic 6.42T combinatorial generator (`generator.js`) & 3D simulation (`game3d.js`)
  - `src/web/` — WebGL2 3D renderer, 2D visualizers, 48 kHz AudioWorklet synth, Studio UI (`index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`)
  - `programs/` — 4 living `.plang` species (`quantum_chronicle`, `aegis_drift`, `synth_reactor`, `cipher_vault`)
  - `artifacts/` — Deterministic compiled 98,304 B `.hbin` binaries + `manifest.json`
  - `lean/` — 6 pure Lean 4.35.0 `module` proof files + `PlanariaProofs.lean` + Palomar `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `comparator.json`
  - `test/` — 28-suite verification, property-based, metamorphic & regression harness (`verify.mjs`)
  - `examples/` — 3 runnable zero-dependency scripts (`01-mitosis`, `02-byzantine`, `03-xenograft`)
  - `scripts/` — Build, statistical benchmark, mutation tester, linter, citation checker, Pages builder, manifest generator, repo audit
  - `paper/` & `dist/` — AMS-LaTeX white paper (`main.tex`), Markdown edition, frozen PDF & arXiv tarball
  - `docs/` — Architecture, ADRs, benchmarks, configuration, operations, threat model, preregistration, FAQ, glossary, run log, 10-pass red-team review
- **Status:** active

## Commands

Every command works from a clean clone (see `justfile` and `scripts/dev.sh`):

- `just setup` — verify Node.js >=20 and Lean 4.35.0 toolchains (zero npm runtime deps)
- `just build` — deterministically compile all 4 `.plang` species to `artifacts/*.hbin`
- `just test` — run all 28 verification, property-based, regression, and example suites (`npm test`)
- `just mutate` — run 10 surgical mutants (`scripts/mutation-test.mjs`; target 10/10 killed)
- `just lint` — report-only syntax, security-sink, placeholder, entity, and JSDoc type checks
- `just bench` — run 4-architecture Monte Carlo + Wilson 95% CI + McNemar + Holm–Bonferroni benchmarks (`npm run benchmark`)
- `just lean` — build Lean 4.35.0 proofs and run multi-kernel verification (`leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `lake check --paranoid`, `lake comparator --paranoid`)
- `just paper` — compile `paper/main.tex` via Tectonic into `dist/Donahue_2026_planaria.pdf`
- `just reproduce` — clean end-to-end build -> test -> mutate -> lint -> bench -> Lean audit
- `just audit` — score this repo against Build Standard v1.2.0 (`scripts/audit-repo.sh` / `Audit-Repo.ps1`)
- `just deploy` / `just rollback` — build static GitHub Pages bundle (`_site/`) / revert latest Pages release commit
- `just release X.Y.Z` — bump `VERSION`/`package.json`, commit to `main`, create plain tag `vX.Y.Z`, push

## Hard rules

- **R1.** Nothing may gate, block, or slow a commit or push. No branch protection, no required status checks, no commit/tag signing, no git hooks, no blocking lint/SAST/SBOM gates (report-only only).
- **R2.** Commit and push straight to `main`. No PRs, no feature branches. Fixes for red CI are follow-up commits to `main`.
- **R3.** CI is informational.
- **R4.** Banned: Dependabot, Renovate, PR templates, CodeRabbit, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `FUNDING.yml`.
- **R5.** One-person lean, not corporate.
- **R6.** Never fabricate any claim, number, badge, DOI, screenshot, or test result. Unverified means labeled unverified.
- **R7.** Classify every finding as exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
- **R8.** Precedence: owner's explicit instruction > hard rules > Build Standard items > ecosystem conventions.

## Known traps

- **PowerShell bracketed paths:** The canonical workspace path contains `[Vibe Coded (AI)]`; always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets.
- **CRLF vs LF in `results/lean4-audit.txt`:** Always write `results/lean4-audit.txt` with pure Unix LF (`\n`) so SHA-256 digests match Linux CI.
- **No fabricated LLC entity:** Author affiliation is `Independent Researcher (0thernes project), Spokane, WA, USA` — never claim an unformed LLC corporate entity.
- **AEGIS_DRIFT S1_CORE_LOGIC budget:** Bundle 1 (`S1_CORE_LOGIC`) has a hard 1,328-byte limit (332 PVM-32 instructions). Always verify `npm run build` after any `codegen.js` change.
- **Lean 4.35.0 `module` mode:** Keep spec defs `@[expose] public`, avoid `by decide` subproofs inside `Fin` indices of `@[expose] public def` (use `fin16` with `Nat.zero_lt_succ 15`), and keep `Challenge` out of `defaultTargets` so `lake check --paranoid` sees zero `sorryAx`.
- **GitHub Pages subpaths:** Never use root-anchored `/src/...` or `/programs/...` paths in `src/web/`; always resolve via `./src/web/...` in HTML and `new URL('../../...', import.meta.url)` in JS.

# CLAIMS.md — Falsifiable Claims Ledger (`PLANARIA v2.3.0`)

Every substantive engineering, mathematical, and experimental claim made in PLANARIA's repository, README, and White Paper is enumerated below alongside its **exact verification boundary** (`LEAN-PROVED`, `EMPIRICAL`, `SYSTEM-TEST`, or `BOUNDARY`), **evidence artifact**, and **explicit falsification criterion ("What would prove us wrong")**.

> **Honest Scope Boundary:** PLANARIA solves **0 / 1,900** open conjectures in [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) (see [10-Pass Audit](docs/reviews/2026-11-25-10-pass-red-team-audit.md)). Every claim below is strictly scoped to PLANARIA's `.hbin` coding architecture, Plang/PVM-32 runtime, 4-qubit/temporal simulation, and pure Lean 4.35.0 formalizations.

| ID | Claim | Verification Class | Evidence & Machine Proof | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Falsification Criterion) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **C01** | PLANARIA's exact executable $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ arithmetic modulo `0x11D` forms a characteristic-2 field and decodes every 2-cell Cauchy Stratum-0 pair losslessly across all $256^2$ byte inputs and all distinct coordinates $x_0 \neq x_1 \in [2, 255]$. | `LEAN-PROVED` (6 kernels) + `SYSTEM-TEST` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/GF256.lean` (`gf256Field`, `gf256_cauchy2_exact_decode`, `gf256_cauchy2_nonvacuous_witness`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 01 & 25 | Finding any $(a,b,c) \in [0,255]^3$ violating a field axiom, any $a \in [1,255]$ with $a \cdot a^{-1} \neq 1$, or any distinct $x_0, x_1 \ge 2$ failing lossless Cauchy decode. |
| **C02** | Any zero-overlap 50/50 bisection of a pristine 98,304 B `.hbin` (including unaligned prime byte offsets such as `49,177`) produces two disjoint halves that BOTH decode to Stratum 3 and independently regenerate a bit-exact SHA-256 copy of the original 98,304 B binary. | `LEAN-PROVED` (schedule & bounds) + `SYSTEM-TEST` + `EMPIRICAL` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/MitosisBounds.lean` (`planaria_schedule_nodup_and_sorted_halves`, `mitosis_unaligned_cut_guarantee`); `test/verify.mjs` Suite 04; `examples/01-mitosis-roundtrip.mjs`; `results/benchmarks.json` (`mitosisResults`) | Any balanced cut offset $c \in [48701, 49597]$ where either disjoint half fails to decode to Stratum 3 or regenerates a single byte differing from the original SHA-256 digest. |
| **C03** | Every 512 B `.hbin` cell repairs up to 8 arbitrary byte errors per RS(254,238) lane and up to 16 contiguous burst error bytes across the 508 B interleaved payload; 17+ contiguous burst bytes strictly exceed the unique decoding radius $t = 8$ in at least one lane. | `LEAN-PROVED` (tight upper & lower bounds) + `SYSTEM-TEST` + `EMPIRICAL` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/ByzantineImmune.lean` (`interleaved_burst_16_even_odd_bound`, `interleaved_burst_17_exceeds_radius`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 02 & 07; `results/benchmarks.json` (`radiationSweep`) | A $\le 16$ B contiguous burst within the 508 B RS body failing exact repair, OR a 17 B contiguous burst fitting with $\le 8$ errors in both lanes. |
| **C04** | Under 80% uniform random cell erasure (only ~20% of the binary remaining), PLANARIA achieves strictly higher bootable survival than BOTH a traditional linear binary (`LINBIN01`), a single-stratum `RS(40,16)` archive, AND an equal-storage flat `RS(192,48)` monolithic archive (identical 96 KiB footprint & 48-chunk raw payload capacity), with $p_{\text{Holm}} < 10^{-6}$ (paired McNemar exact test, $n = 40$ paired seeds). | `LEAN-PROVED` (separation witness) + `EMPIRICAL` (Wilson 95% CI, McNemar, Holm–Bonferroni) | `lean/PlanariaProofs/StratumAnastomosis.lean` (`zero_cliff_strict_separation`); `results/benchmarks.json` (`survivalCurve` @ `dropPct=80`); `test/verify.mjs` Suite 06 | Re-running `npm run benchmark` and observing equal-storage `RS(192,48)` or `LINBIN01` achieving non-inferior survival at 80% erasure, or Holm–Bonferroni $p_{\text{Holm}} \ge 0.05$. |
| **C05** | Whenever Stratum-0 Stem Nucleus retains $\ge 2$ authentic cells, PVM-32 vascular anastomosis (`resolveOrgan` / `resolveRenderer`) NEVER crashes across any amputation of Bundles 1–6 and never invokes Bundle 0 (`KERNEL`) or Bundle 6 (`GENOME`) via `ORGAN_CALL`; Lean's `viabilityLevel` matches `src/core/hbin.js` Step 4 bit-for-bit. | `LEAN-PROVED` + `SYSTEM-TEST` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/StratumAnastomosis.lean` (`resolveOrgan_zero_crash_safety`, `viability_s3_without_b2_matches_hbin`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 09 & 20 | Any valid shard profile with $b_0 \ge 2$ that causes an unhandled VM crash, executes Bundle 6 as code, or yields a different `maxViableStratum` between JS and Lean. |
| **C06** | Under collision-resistant SHA-256 Merkle binding with a pinned lineage root (`pinnedRootHex`), `merkleQuarantine` admits zero forged Byzantine Trojan cells and preserves 100% of authentic cells; without a pinned root, ties fail closed (`none`) and majority Sybil floods override unpinned quorum (explicit threat boundary). | `LEAN-PROVED` (with non-vacuity witnesses) + `SYSTEM-TEST` + `EMPIRICAL` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/ByzantineImmune.lean` (`merkle_quarantine_zero_contamination`, `unpinned_quorum_honest_majority`, `unpinned_quorum_tie_fail_closed`, `unpinned_quorum_sybil_counterexample`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 08 & 12; `examples/02-byzantine-quarantine.mjs` | Any RS-valid forged Trojan cell with a non-matching Merkle root entering the Cauchy decoder under pinned-root mode, OR an exact-tie unpinned stream electing an arbitrary root. |
| **C07** | Cross-species Xenografting (`allowXenograft: true`) preserves host lineage sovereignty (Bundles 0 and 6 are immutable; dead hosts with $b_0 < 2$ never graft) and enforces ABI-signature and bundle-ID equality; valid cross-species chimeras execute deterministically inside PVM-32's `& 0xFFF` RAM sandbox and bounded instruction budget with zero traps. | `LEAN-PROVED` + `SYSTEM-TEST` + `EMPIRICAL` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/XenograftABI.lean` (`pvm32_ram_bounds_invariant`, `pvm32_bounded_termination`, `xenograft_sovereign_b0_b6_immutable`, `xenograft_abi_safety`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 10, 20 & 26; `examples/03-xenograft-chimera.mjs`; `results/benchmarks.json` (`xenograftMatrix`) | Any donor overwriting host B0/B6, grafting onto a dead host, mismatching ABI signature, escaping 4,096-word RAM bounds, or hanging beyond `maxInsnBudget`. |
| **C08** | All 7 core 4-qubit complex gates (`X`, `Y`, `Z`, scaled `H`, `CNOT`, `CZ`, `SWAP`) conserve statevector norm identically across all 16 basis amplitudes; `QuantumRegister` achieves Tsirelson's $2\sqrt{2}$ Horodecki CHSH bound on Bell states and $|M_4| = 4.0$ on 4-qubit GHZ states; `TemporalEngine` provides bounded 360-frame lossless rewind without skill-point duplication. | `LEAN-PROVED` + `SYSTEM-TEST` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/QuantumTemporal.lean` (`pauliX4Q..swap4Q`, `snapshot_buffer_capacity_and_exact_pop`); `test/verify.mjs` Suites 13, 14, 25, 26 & 27 | Any gate sequence drifting from unit norm beyond floating-point tolerance ($10^{-12}$), separable state exceeding $|S| > 2.0$, or rewind failing to restore skills/state snapshots. |
| **C09** | The discrete reachable cross-product of PLANARIA's 1/1 procedural generator (`80,640` weapons $\times$ `3,072` armors $\times$ `25,920` reachable NPCs) equals exactly `6,421,059,993,600` ($> 6.42 \times 10^{12}$) before continuous stat gradients and 64-bit SHA-256 lineage IDs. | `LEAN-PROVED` + `SYSTEM-TEST` | `lean/PlanariaProofs/QuantumTemporal.lean` (`combinatorial_1of1_space_exceeds_6_trillion`); `src/world/generator.js`; `test/verify.mjs` Suite 15 | Any unreachable archetype/rarity pair counted in `combinatorialSpaceMetrics()`, or arithmetic mismatch between JS and Lean. |
| **C10** | All 70 formal theorems in `lean/Solution.lean` match the standalone `lean/Challenge.lean` specification verbatim, depend ONLY on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (zero `sorryAx`, zero `Lean.ofReduceBool`, zero `Lean.trustCompiler`), and pass independent multi-kernel verification (`leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, plus `lean4lean` in Linux CI `lake comparator --paranoid`). | `LEAN-PROVED` (6-kernel) | `lean/Challenge.lean`, `lean/Solution.lean`, `lean/comparator.json`, `results/lean4-audit.txt`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Any forbidden axiom appearing in `#print axioms`, any `lake comparator --paranoid` mismatch, or any kernel rejecting the exported NDJSON. |

# LIMITATIONS.md — Honest Boundaries, Real-vs-Metaphor & Open Dilemmas

This document states explicitly what **PLANARIA v2.3.0** does, what it does **NOT** do, where its engineering and mathematical guarantees end, and which terms are computational metaphors rather than physical or biological claims.

## 1. Real vs. Metaphor Boundary (Strict Epistemic Discipline)

| Term Used in PLANARIA | What Is **REAL** (Verified Code & Math) | What Is **METAPHOR / NOT CLAIMED** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Planarian Mitosis / Regeneration** | Deterministic Cauchy MDS erasure coding over $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ with a zero-tie integer placement schedule so two disjoint 50% byte halves independently reconstruct 100% of the 98,304 B binary. | **NOT** wet-lab developmental biology, bioelectricity, stem-cell morphogenesis, or a solution to Mega-Atlas `BIO-031` / `SUB-001`. |
| **Living Species / Neural / Organism** | Four deterministic PVM-32 bytecode programs (`QUANTUM_CHRONICLE`, `AEGIS_DRIFT`, `SYNTH_REACTOR`, `CIPHER_VAULT`) executing inside a 4,096-word sandboxed VM with reactive AI heuristics (`playerProfile` EMA). | **NOT** biological life, sentience, autonomous self-replicating malware, or trained deep neural networks. |
| **Vascular Anastomosis** | Explicit software fallback table (`resolveOrgan`) routing `ORGAN_CALL` from higher strata (S3/S2) down to lower strata (S1/S0) or no-op stubs when bundles lack rank $k$. | **NOT** surgical biology or general arbitrary x86/ARM binary hot-patching. |
| **Byzantine Immune System** | Depth-8 SHA-256 Merkle authentication filtering cells against `pinnedRootHex` (or strict unique-majority quorum $\ge 2$) prior to Cauchy matrix inversion. | **NOT** an adaptive biological immune system; without `pinnedRootHex`, a coordinated majority Sybil flood overrides unpinned quorum (explicitly proved in `unpinned_quorum_sybil_counterexample`). |
| **4-Qubit Quantum Register / CHSH / WKB** | Exact classical simulation of a 16-amplitude complex statevector (`Float64Array`), exact Horodecki $3\times 3$ correlation-tensor CHSH, exact 4-qubit Mermin $M_4$, Werner depolarizing channel, and textbook 1D rectangular-barrier WKB transmission formula. | **NOT** quantum hardware, physical entanglement, or new quantum physics; simulation scales as $O(2^n)$ and is capped at $n = 4$ qubits ($16$ complex amplitudes). |
| **6 Orders of Magnitude ($10^{-15}\text{ m} \to 10^9\text{ m}$)** | Six procedurally themed 3D WebGL2 visual/audio/tunnel-boost stage biomes with logarithmic scale labels. | **NOT** a multi-scale relativistic/QFT physics engine; spatial coordinates live in a normalized $[-34, 34]$ arena coordinate system. |
| **Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas** | Audited against all **1,900** problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`. | **Verdict: `0 / 1,900` open problems solved.** PLANARIA is a systems engineering & formal-verification artifact adjacent to `SYS-045`, `CS-053`, and `AI-005`. |

## 2. Technical & Cryptographic Limitations

1. **4× Storage Overhead (192 coded cells / 48 source chunks):**
   Holographic survivability and 50/50 mitosis require $4\times$ payload expansion ($15{,}936\text{ B}$ raw bytecode capacity inside a $98{,}304\text{ B}$ `.hbin` file). PLANARIA is designed for compact, mission-critical, high-survivability micro-executables, NOT multi-gigabyte desktop applications.
2. **Sybil Majority Boundary in Unpinned Mode:**
   When `pinnedRootHex` is NOT supplied to `decodeHbin()`, an adversary who injects strictly more RS-valid forged cells under one coordinated fake Merkle root than surviving authentic host cells will win unpinned quorum election (`unpinned_quorum_sybil_counterexample`). For hostile channels, callers MUST pin `pinnedRootHex` (or verify against a signed manifest).
3. **128-Bit Truncated Merkle Nodes:**
   To fit an 8-level Merkle inclusion proof inside each 512 B cell ($8 \times 16 = 128\text{ B}$), internal Merkle digests truncate FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 to 128 bits. This provides 128-bit second-preimage resistance and 64-bit birthday collision resistance — strong for single-organism forensic integrity, but below 256-bit post-quantum collision margins.
4. **JavaScript-to-Lean Extraction Gap:**
   The 70 Lean 4.35.0 theorems verify mathematical models of GF(2^8), Cauchy 2×2 decoding, the integer placement schedule, 4-stratum viability, RS(254,238) burst bounds, Merkle quarantine, unpinned quorum, `BitVec 32` RAM masking, and 4-qubit unitarity. The JavaScript runtime (`src/*.js`) is NOT automatically extracted from Lean; correspondence between JS and Lean is maintained via statement-fidelity audits, differential tests, and 10/10 mutation testing (`docs/reviews/2026-11-25-10-pass-red-team-audit.md`).
5. **General $k \times k$ Cauchy Non-Singularity:**
   Lean 4 proves universal $2 \times 2$ Cauchy non-singularity and exact decoding (`cauchy2_exact_decode`, `gf256_cauchy2_exact_decode` for Stratum 0 $k = 2$). Higher bundles ($k \in \{4, 6, 8, 16\}$) rely on the classical Cauchy determinant theorem in prose and empirical property-based testing across 25+ randomized $(k, n)$ configurations in Suite 25 (not yet generalized to arbitrary $k \times k$ determinants in pure zero-Mathlib Lean 4).
6. **Desktop-First Browser Requirements & Single-Machine Benchmarks:**
   The Studio 3D viewport requires WebGL2 (falling back gracefully to 2D PVM-32 + Tissue Surgery when unavailable). Timing benchmarks in `results/benchmarks.json` reflect one workstation (CPU/Node version recorded in JSON) and are not cross-architecture hardware guarantees.

## 3. Open Design Dilemmas (Logged per Build Standard R7 & R8)

- **Dilemma D1 — Non-Commercial License vs. OSI/JOSS/Mathlib Eligibility:**
  `LICENSE` uses the owner-mandated *Cosmogonic License — Non-Commercial Research & Play* (per Turn-1 explicit instruction, which takes precedence under Hard Rule `R8`). Because non-commercial clauses are not OSI-approved, PLANARIA is ineligible for JOSS submission or upstream Mathlib inclusion unless dual-licensed (e.g., Apache-2.0 / MIT) by the owner in a future release. See [ADR-0004](docs/adr/0004-non-commercial-license-vs-osi-dilemma.md).
- **Dilemma D2 — Ephemeral vs. Persistent Attestation Signing:**
  Running `npm run benchmark` without `PLANARIA_SIGNING_KEY_PEM` produces an explicitly labeled `ephemeral-self-consistency-seal` Ed25519 signature (proving internal bundle consistency only). External release authenticity relies on GitHub Release `SHA256SUMS`, SLSA provenance (`actions/attest-build-provenance@v4`), Git commit hashes, and Software Heritage snapshots.

# REPLICATION.md — Clean-Clone Reproduction & Independent Replication Protocol

This protocol lets any independent engineer or academic reviewer verify **every single claim, test, mutant, statistical benchmark, Lean 4.35.0 proof, and PDF paper** from a clean clone using only open-source toolchains.

## 1. Prerequisites

| Tool | Required Version | Purpose | Required For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Node.js** | `>= 20.0.0` (verified on `v25.8.2` & CI `v22`) | Runtime, compiler, VM, 28 suites, mutation suite, benchmarks (zero npm deps!) | Core build, tests, Studio |
| **Lean 4 (`elan`)** | `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` (pinned in `lean/lean-toolchain`) | 70 formal proofs + 6-kernel verification + Palomar comparator | Formal verification |
| **bubblewrap (`bwrap`)** | Linux only (`sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap`) | Sandboxed `lake check --paranoid` & `lake comparator --paranoid` | Linux 6-kernel sandbox |
| **Tectonic** | `>= 0.15` (optional) | Recompile `paper/main.tex` -> `dist/Donahue_2026_planaria.pdf` | White paper PDF build |

## 2. Exact Clean-Clone Reproduction Commands

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/planaria.git
cd planaria

# 1. Deterministic build of all 4 living .hbin organisms (98,304 B each)
npm run build

# 2. Full 28-suite verification, property-based, metamorphic & regression harness
npm test

# 3. Static analysis, security-sink, placeholder & citation checks
npm run lint
npm run check:citations

# 4. Surgical mutation testing (10 planted mutants -> expect 10/10 = 100.0% KILLED)
npm run mutate

# 5. Reproducible 4-architecture Monte Carlo + Wilson 95% CI + McNemar + Holm-Bonferroni benchmarks
npm run benchmark

# 6. Pure Lean 4.35.0 build & verbatim 70-theorem #print axioms audit
cd lean
lake clean && lake build
lake env lean PlanariaProofs.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution

# 7. Full 6-kernel sandboxed verification & Palomar Challenge/Solution comparator (Linux with bwrap)
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..

# 8. Optional: recompile AMS-LaTeX White Paper PDF
tectonic -X compile paper/main.tex --outdir dist

# 9. Launch live 3D WebGL2 Studio on http://127.0.0.1:4174/
npm start
```

Or run the full automated pipeline via `just reproduce` (or `./scripts/dev.sh reproduce`).

- `lean/`: `70` audited `#print axioms` lines containing ONLY subsets of `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`; zero `sorryAx` / `ofReduceBool` / `trustCompiler`; exit code `0` across all 6 kernels (`leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`) and `lake comparator --paranoid`.

# PLANARIA Architecture (`v2.3.0`)

## System Overview

PLANARIA replaces monolithic header-dependent executables with **headerless, spatially stratified holographic cellular binaries (`.hbin`)** paired with a fault-isolated register virtual machine (`PVM-32`) capable of autonomous multi-stratum control-flow anastomosis. Every byte of a compiled `98,304`-byte `.hbin` organism consists exclusively of `192` self-synchronizing `512`-byte cellular frames arranged via an arithmetic coprime scatter schedule so that arbitrary spatial cuts partition the organism with zero byte overlap while preserving full algebraic reconstructibility.

```text
  .plang Source (4 Living Species)
        │  src/compiler/{lexer,parser,codegen,isa}.js
        ▼
  7 Organ Bundles (B0..B6: Stem, CoreLogic, PrimaryGfx, HdFx, AudioSynth, StateSchema, Genome)
        │  src/core/{gf256,cauchy,rs,sha256,hbin}.js
        ▼
  4-Stratum Progressive Cauchy MDS Encoding over GF(2^8) [poly 0x11D]
    ├── Stratum 0 (B0, k=4)  -> 36 cells  [min survival: 2.08% ideal / ~12% spatial cut]
    ├── Stratum 1 (B1, k=8)  -> 40 cells  [min survival: 4.17% ideal / ~18% spatial cut]
    ├── Stratum 2 (B2, k=16) -> 48 cells  [min survival: 8.33% ideal / ~28% spatial cut]
    └── Stratum 3 (B3..B6)   -> 68 cells  [full HD/Audio/Genome regeneration at 50% mitosis]
        │  Each 512 B Cell = 4 B Sync ('PLN\xB7') + 2x Interleaved RS(254,238)
        │                  = 476 B Payload (Header + 332 B Cauchy Shard + 8x16 B Merkle Proof)
        ▼
  192-Cell Scatter-Scheduled .hbin Binary (98,304 B)
        │  decodeHbin() -> Sync Scan + Iterative Backward Flywheel + RS(254,238) Repair
        │               -> Depth-8 Domain-Separated SHA-256-128 Merkle Quarantine
        │               -> GF(2^8) Cauchy MDS Recovery + Optional ABI-Verified Xenografting
        ▼
  PVM-32 Sandboxed Virtual Machine (src/vm/pvm32.js)
    ├── 32x32-bit regs (r0=0, r1..r7 ABI, r8..r17 scratch, r18..r29 locals, r30/r31 frame)
    ├── 4,096-word RAM strictly masked (& 0xFFF), bounded instruction fuel per frame
    ├── ORGAN_CALL descending anastomosis (S3 -> S2 -> S1 -> S0 fallback)
    └── Live coupling to 4-Qubit Register + Temporal RingBuffer + WebGL2 3D + 48 kHz AudioWorklet
```

## Layer 1 — Coding Theory, Cryptography & Cellular Codec (`src/core/`)

| Module | Responsibility | Key Invariants |
|---|---|---|
| `gf256.js` | $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ arithmetic (`0x11D`, generator `0x02`) | Exhaustively verified over all $65{,}536$ pairs (`Suite 01`, `GF256.lean`) |
| `rs.js` | Interleaved `RS(254, 238)` Berlekamp–Massey / Chien / Forney | Repairs $\le 8$ random errors/lane ($16$ B contiguous burst per cell); strictly rejects $9+$ errors/lane (`Suite 02`) |
| `cauchy.js` | Systematic-free Cauchy MDS over $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ ($C_{i,j} = (x_i \oplus y_j)^{-1}$) | Any $k$ distinct `evalX` shards invert losslessly (`k <= 128`, deduplicated); 2x2 singularity impossible (`GF256.lean`) |
| `sha256.js` | Pure JS FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 + Depth-8 Merkle tree (`0x00` leaf / `0x01` internal) | Bit-exact parity with Node OpenSSL (`Suite 03`, `Suite 25`); second-preimage domain separation (`ByzantineImmune.lean`) |
| `hbin.js` | 192-cell scatter scheduler, self-sync scanner, backward flywheel, Merkle quarantine, xenograft engine | Zero-overlap exact/prime mitosis (`MitosisBounds.lean`), O(1) sync-flood rejection, dead-host xenograft refusal, lexical donor tie-break |
| `torture.js` | Deterministic damage injectors (bisection, trisection, bit-rot, burst, unaligned shift, Trojan, overlap-eclipse) | Exact seeded PRNG (`mulberry32`) for paired Monte Carlo comparisons |

### Scatter Schedule Geometry (`CELL_SCHEDULE`)

Each of the `192` cells `(bundleId, shardIdx)` receives a deterministic sort key `key = (73 * idx + 19 * bundleId + 11) mod 192` and is placed in ascending lexicographic order of `(key, bundleId, shardIdx)`. Because `gcd(73, 192) = 1`, the schedule is a bijection (`MitosisBounds.lean: planaria_schedule_nodup_and_sorted_halves`). Every bundle's parity shards distribute uniformly across both the left half (`slots 0..95`) and right half (`slots 96..191`), guaranteeing that EVERY bundle has at least `k` shards on BOTH sides of any exact half-cut (`Suite 04` and `MitosisBounds.lean: planaria_zero_overlap_mitosis`).

## Layer 2 — Plang Compiler & `PVM-32` Virtual Machine (`src/compiler/`, `src/vm/`)

- **Plang Language (`lexer.js`, `parser.js`, `codegen.js`, `isa.js`):** Compiles structured 7-bundle living organisms (`programs/*.plang`) to fixed-width 32-bit RISC bytecode. Enforces `MAX_PARSE_DEPTH = 128`, `Map`-based symbol tables (immune to `Object.prototype` collisions), strict scratch-register overflow guard (`rR > 17`), deterministic `LI r1, 0` on bare `return;`, and unsigned 32-bit decimal/hex literal parsing with signed negation range checks.
- **`PVM-32` (`pvm32.js`):** Deterministic 32-bit virtual machine with `& 0xFFF` RAM address sandboxing, exact `BigInt` integer square root (`ISQRT`), bounded per-frame fuel preventing infinite loops, strict Bundle 6 non-execution (`bundleCode[6] === null`), and `ORGAN_CALL` vascular anastomosis.
- **Control Baseline (`linear-twin.js`):** `LINBIN01` traditional headered linear binary with SHA-256 integrity footer, plus equal-storage flat `RS(192, 48)` baseline in `scripts/benchmark.mjs` for rigorous ablation.

## Layer 3 — 4-Qubit Quantum Engine, Temporal Causality & WebGL2 Studio (`src/quantum/`, `src/world/`, `src/web/`)

- **Quantum Register (`qengine.js`):** Exact $2^4 = 16$-amplitude complex double-precision statevector supporting `X/Y/Z/H/S/T/RX/RY/RZ/CNOT/CZ/SWAP`, Werner depolarizing decoherence ($V = e^{-\gamma t} \to 0$), exact Horodecki $3\times 3$ correlation-tensor CHSH maximum $S_{\max} = 2\sqrt{\lambda_0 + \lambda_1}$ (reaching $2\sqrt{2}$ on Bell states), 4-qubit Mermin $|M_4|$ witness (reaching $8.0$ on $\mathrm{GHZ}_4$), WKB barrier tunneling, Heisenberg uncertainty, and Zeno suppression.
- **Temporal Engine (`temporal.js`):** $O(1)$ circular 360-frame `RingBuffer` recording full deterministic snapshots (player kinematics, HP, XP, skills, chrono-energy, active NPCs, delayed echo shots, scale override) enabling causality-consistent rewind with zero skill-point duplication exploits.
- **3D World & WebGL2 Renderer (`generator.js`, `game3d.js`, `renderer3d.js`, `audio-worklet.js`):** Deterministic 64-bit seeded 6-order stage & gear generator (`6.42T` reachable combinations), pure WebGL2 GLSL 300 es pipeline with CPU normal matrices and float64 phase reduction, plus a lock-free 48 kHz PolyBLEP `AudioWorklet` synthesizer coupled directly to `PVM-32` Bundle 4 registers.

## Layer 4 — CLI, Hardened HTTP Server & Static Pages (`bin/`, `server.mjs`, `scripts/`)

- **CLI (`bin/planaria.mjs`):** 9 subcommands (`compile`, `inspect`, `run`, `bisect`, `fuse`, `heal`, `damage`, `xenograft`, `disasm`), strict flag validation, explicit `--allow-unpinned-xenograft` opt-in, and exit code `3` on VM traps.
- **HTTP Server (`server.mjs`):** Zero-dependency static host bound to `127.0.0.1:4174` with `/healthz`, TOCTOU-safe `openSync`/`fstatSync`, symlink-escape protection, strict CSP, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `nosniff`, and static non-echoing 404 responses.
- **Static Pages Builder (`scripts/build-pages.mjs`):** Assembles a subpath-safe `_site/` bundle for GitHub Pages with zero root-anchored asset URLs.

## Layer 5 — 6-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Proofs (`lean/`, `formalization.yaml`)

Six zero-Mathlib `module` files (`GF256`, `MitosisBounds`, `StratumAnastomosis`, `ByzantineImmune`, `XenograftABI`, `QuantumTemporal`) prove **70 theorems** using only Lean's standard axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, exported via Palomar `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` / `comparator.json` and independently checked across 6 distinct kernels (`lean4`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, plus `lean4lean` & `lake comparator --paranoid` in Ubuntu Linux CI).

# Empirical Benchmarks & Performance Budgets (`v2.3.0`)

All measurements below are generated deterministically by [`scripts/benchmark.mjs`](../scripts/benchmark.mjs) (`schema: PLANARIA-BENCHMARKS-1.2`, pre-registered in [`docs/preregistration.md`](preregistration.md)) and stored verbatim in [`results/benchmarks.json`](../results/benchmarks.json).

**Reference Machine:** Node.js `v25.8.2` on Windows x64, Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX (24 cores), 47.4 GiB RAM.

---

## 1. Paired 4-Architecture Random Erasure Survival Curve (`N = 40` Paired Seeds / Point)

Compares `AEGIS_DRIFT.hbin` (`98,304` B) against three baselines evaluated on the **exact same 40 deterministic random seeds** per erasure threshold:
1. **`LINBIN01`**: Monolithic headered linear executable with SHA-256 footer.
2. **`RS(40, 16)` Cliff**: Single-stratum flat erasure code ($40$ cells, $k = 16$).
3. **Equal-Storage Flat `RS(192, 48)`**: Exact same `98,304` B file size and `192 × 512` B cell count as PLANARIA, using a flat $k = 48$ all-or-nothing threshold (`25%` cliff) to isolate **progressive stratification** from total byte budget.

| Erasure (%) | `LINBIN01` (%) [95% CI] | `RS(40,16)` (%) | Equal-Storage `RS(192,48)` (%) [95% CI] | **PLANARIA `.hbin`** (%) [95% CI] | Mean Cap. (%) | Stratum (`S3/S2/S1/S0`) | vs. `RS(192,48)` Cohen's $h$ | vs. `RS(192,48)` $p_{\text{Holm}}$ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---:|---:|
| 0% | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | `40/0/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 12% | 32.5 `[20.1, 48.0]` | 100.0 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | `40/0/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 44% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 100.0 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | `40/0/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 60% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 57.5 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 88.8 | `22/18/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 72% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 2.5 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 72.5 | `0/36/4/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| **76%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` *(Cliff)* | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | **65.6** | `0/25/15/0` | **`3.142`** | **`4.55e-11`** |
| **80%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **95.0** `[83.5, 98.6]` | **55.6** | `0/13/25/0` | **`2.691`** | **`1.75e-10`** |
| **84%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **87.5** `[73.9, 94.5]` | **39.4** | `0/3/22/10` | **`2.419`** | **`1.34e-9`** |
| **88%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **82.5** `[68.1, 91.3]` | **31.3** | `0/1/15/17` | **`2.278`** | **`5.12e-9`** |
| **92%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **65.0** `[49.5, 77.9]` | **19.4** | `0/0/5/21` | **`1.875`** | **`6.26e-7`** |
| **96%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **32.5** `[20.1, 48.0]` | **8.1** | `0/0/0/13` | **`1.213`** | **`4.88e-3`** |

**Honest Trade-Off Note:** Between `52%` and `72%` random erasure, Equal-Storage `RS(192, 48)` recovers 100% of all bytes (full Stratum 3) whenever $\ge 48/192$ cells survive, whereas PLANARIA gracefully steps down to Stratum 2 (`S2`) and Stratum 1 (`S1`) as higher-rate bundles drop below their thresholds. Above `75%` erasure, Equal-Storage `RS(192, 48)` suffers an instantaneous cliff to `0.0%` availability, while PLANARIA remains bootable with statistically overwhelming superiority ($p_{\text{Holm}} \le 4.88 \times 10^{-3}$ across every threshold `76%..96%`).

## 2. Radiation Burst Sweep, Byzantine Quarantine & Unaligned Mitosis

- **Contiguous Burst Radiation in ALL 192 Cells Simultaneously:**
  - `0..16 B/cell` (up to `3,072` corrupted bytes = `3.13%` file-wide): **192/192 cells repaired (100% SHA-256 exact regeneration)**; `LINBIN01` dies at `2 B/cell`.
  - `18..22 B/cell` (past tight interleaved RS bound $2t = 16$): **0/192 cells repaired, 0 silent miscorrections** (confirms Theorem IV.5–IV.6).
- **Byzantine Trojan Flood (`1, 5, 20, 60, 192` forged RS-valid cells prepended):**
  - **Merkle Quarantine ON:** `100%` quarantined (`1/1`, `5/5`, `20/20`, `60/60`, `192/192`), `100%` exact SHA-256 match.
  - **Merkle Quarantine OFF:** Even **1 single Trojan** poisons `470 / 472` bytes (`99.6%`) of `S0_STEM_NUCLEUS` (`469–472 B` across `1..192` Trojans).
- **Zero-Overlap Unaligned 50/50 Bisection (`49152, 49153, 49177, 48701, 49597, 49000`):**
  - **100% (6/6 cut offsets)** regenerate SHA-256 bit-exact `98,304`-byte parent binaries from **BOTH** disjoint halves in `12.57–14.21 ms` combined.
- **Full 5-Chimera Cross-Species Xenograft Matrix (`60` frames each):**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × SYNTH_REACTOR (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × CIPHER_VAULT (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × QUANTUM_CHRONICLE (S1 Logic)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `QUANTUM_CHRONICLE × SYNTH_REACTOR (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `SYNTH_REACTOR × CIPHER_VAULT (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**

**Historical Trend (Report-Only Tracking, `B27`):**
- `v2.2.0`: Mean decode `8.96 ms`, `PVM-32` `27.02 MIPS` (`0.082 ms/frame`), 24 suites, 62 Lean theorems.
- `v2.3.0`: Median decode `5.994 ms` (`-33.1%`), `PVM-32` `42.85 MIPS` (`0.041 ms/frame` median, `+58.6%`), 28 suites, `10/10` mutants killed, 70 Lean theorems across 6 kernels. Every Ubuntu CI push uploads `results/benchmarks.json` as a build artifact for ongoing regression comparison.
